sections.title: A perspective shaped by experience
paragraphs: Robert “Coach” Johanson is an associate professor in IBSC. His expertise spans Business English, professional English presentations, sociolinguistics, and second language acquisition.

His educational background includes a doctorate and a master’s degree in Foreign Language Education from the University of Texas at Austin, a master’s degree in East Asian Studies from Harvard University, and a bachelor’s degree combining German linguistics and European history from Northwestern University.

His teaching and research interests include project-based learning, English as a Medium of Instruction, e-learning, flipped classrooms, and body language. His listed scholarship also examines academic writing and the teaching strategies used by EMI instructors following the emergence of generative AI.
